{{Quote|Your solar sailer is very beautiful. It's a pretty rare ship.|Hondo Ohnaka|<ref name="captured">{{TCW|Dooku Captured}}</ref>}}
'''Dooku's solar sailer''' was a heavily modified [[Punworcca 116-class interstellar sloop/Legends|''Punworcca 116''-class interstellar sloop]] belonging to [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], also known as [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Tyranus. Dooku used this [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] to escape from the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Tyranus's vessel was a unique mix of [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] engineering and [[Pre-Republic era|pre-Republic]] [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] technology. The vessel was [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by a [[FA-4 pilot droid/Legends|FA-4 pilot droid]] and could travel through realspace and hyperspace.

==Characteristics==
===Design===
Built on the spaceframe of a [[Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective/Legends|Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective]] ''Punworcca 116''-class sloop, Dooku's solar sailer was a unique melding of Geonosian and Gree technology. The sloop was 15.2 meters long, 4.6 meters wide, and 4.8 meters deep. Like many Geonosian starships, it had two multifunctional bow prongs, with an orb-like [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] module positioned between the two, and a crew hold at the stern of the craft.<ref name="SWAofCICS" />

The dark surface hull of the solar sailer was composed of heavy metals that were preciously rare on Geonosis. The interior of the craft was tailored to Dooku's refined tastes and his role as leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and was fitted with an extensive databook library, strategic chart displays, and ornate decorations and sleeping quarters.<ref name="SWAofCICS" />

===Armament===
Lightly armed, the solar sailer carried rows of 84 narrow-beam [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor-repulsor emitters]] along the bow prongs that could act as offensive grapples. Additionally, the cockpit module could be replaced by a dedicated weapons or sensor orb if necessary, and the piloting controls routed to the main hold.<ref name="SWAofCICS" />

===Propulsion===
The most unique aspect of Dooku's solar sailer was its [[Solar sailer/Legends|sail]], an ancient [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] artifact supplied by Dooku himself. Unlike most solar sails, which unfurled to [[Moon/Legends|moon-like]] diameters and were pushed by [[Tachyon/Legends|tachyon]] streams or [[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]] [[Laser/Legends|lasers]], Dooku's unique sail had no discernible power source. This made the craft especially difficult to track through hyperspace, allowing it to get to and from highly guarded planets such as [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] undetected. Dooku's sail was composed of an exotic matter that reflected otherwise-undetectable supralight emissions, and achieved great performance across the entire [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] with a much smaller diameter than most sails.<ref name="SWAofCICS" /> The independence afforded by such a unique ship enhanced Dooku's mystique in Geonosian eyes, and a number of [[Warrior caste (Geonosian)/Legends|soldier drones]] even came to believe that Dooku's ship flew by [[Magic/Legends|magic]].<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

The solar sailer was also equipped with a conventional [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]], and the tractor beam emitters along the bow prongs could serve as steering aids when there were surrounding objects to push and pull against. The spread of [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]] and [[Particle shield/Legends|particle shield]] energies around the prongs could additionally be adjusted to provided extra mobility when in [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. Dooku tended to rely on an [[FA-4 pilot droid]] to fly his vehicle.<ref name="SWAofCICS" />

==History==
[[File:SolorSailer-DB.png|thumb|left|250px|Dooku's solar sailer with its solar sail deployed]]
[[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] had this sloop presented to him as a gift from [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]]. As of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], shortly after joining the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith Order]],<ref name="Bounty Hunter">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> Count Dooku had procured a unique ancient "solar" sail from an antiques dealer in the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]] to add to his sloop. The sail collected an undetectable power source to achieve great speeds with ease unmatched by conventional sails. [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] Poggle was pleased to have ancient technology augment the sloop, as [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] had a long sailing heritage dating back centuries.<ref name="SWAofCICS" /> Fourteen [[Standard day/Legends|standard days]] before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]] confirmed eyewitness reports that Dooku had been spotted earlier in the [[Standard week/Legends|week]] visiting the Gree Enclave, purportedly in search of valuable antiques.<ref name="HNV53154">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|54|news/1352_1.html|Dooku Spotted in Gree Enclave}}</ref><ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

At the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on Geonosis, Dooku had his solar sailer docked in [[Dooku's hangar/Legends|his hangar]]. During a duel with [[Grand Master/Legends|Jedi Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] the solar sailer was lightly skimmed by [[Dooku's lightsaber/Legends|Dooku's lightsaber]] when he tried to attack his previous master. He fled the Battle of Geonosis in it after being waylaid by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. He then rendezvoused with his master, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], at [[The Works/Legends|The Works]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

[[File:Sidious_Dooku_Talk_1.jpg|thumb|right|190px|Dooku reporting to Darth Sidious via a hologram projector in his ship]]
The solar sailer was used by Dooku throughout the Clone Wars as his regular means of travel to significant locations and escape from battles. It at one point sustained damage and crashed on [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]] after a fiery battle in an attempt to escape from Kenobi and Skywalker as their army attacked [[Count Dooku's frigate/Legends|his flagship]]. The [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] droid, along with all equipment on it, was taken apart among a band of [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. The leader of the pirates, [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], commented on the ship's rarity and expensiveness and called it beautiful. To prevent any unnecessary antagonizing of the pirates, the count told Ohnaka to "feel free to help himself to it," unconcerned with his looting of the vessel at the moment. At some point after he escaped imprisonment in their base on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], Dooku had his solar sailer recovered and repaired.<ref name="captured" />

Count Dooku let his new apprentice [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] borrow the solar sailer for his missions to [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]],<ref name="Monster">{{TCW|Monster}}</ref> [[Affa/Legends|Affa]],<ref name="Strange Allies">''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]''</ref> and [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]].<ref name="Witches">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref>

During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], he met with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] on board the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] after departing [[Tythe/Legends|Tythe]] in the vessel.
